scope: Actual frozen FindExtras/RefreshExtras and live entity inheritance, followed by actual BaseItem/Video.UpdateToRepositoryAsync, LibraryManager.UpdateItemsAsync and ItemPersistenceService/EF SQLite first-row save, files, events and failure/cancellation boundaries. Single-item provider controls the decision to call MetadataImport without BeforeSave/probe/provider merge; owner provider performs no save. Saver dispatch/marker, collection membership, image/media-source lists and external-file dispatch are controls. All selected columns and complete Data are recorded; DateLastSaved is range checked before normalization. No complete MetadataService, full scalar mapper, ignore/disc/network/general deletion or release acceptance.
candidateComparison: All 15 actual native samples fully compared on real SQLite/PostgreSQL, with selected columns, complete Data, exact file hashes, dispatch, events, failures and cancellation. Media uses Memory VFS and controlled creation time; instance file deletion is real. Read-only D3 previews are separate from the native mutation trace. Repository fixture reproduces its synchronous controlled provider scheduling without serializing production owned tasks. Additional host tests cover live owner, competing rows, pre-save owner baselines, D3, weak listings and Audio deletion. Scoped evidence does not prove complete MetadataService/scalar mapper, .ignore/disc/network, generic deletion, full scanning or release acceptance.
